cpos.reason: DE*LMS / Last Mile Solutions (Threeforce) supports direct/ad-hoc charging by web/app/QR and exposes the full price to the driver before a session, but the CPO/charge-point owner controls the tariff. Current public German DE*LMS station pages expose exact EVSE IDs while reporting the ad-hoc/direct price as unknown. A current VAB table publishes 0.61 EUR/kWh plus a fair-use fee for DE-LMS / Threeforce, but that table is an eMSP roaming tariff and therefore cannot be substituted for the physical CPO direct price. Searches of official Threeforce/Last Mile Solutions material, exact DE*LMS EVSE records and public aggregators did not reveal a reproducible unauthenticated station-level direct-payment tariff payload. Keep DE*LMS visible but unranked until a direct price can be reproduced for a specific EVSE/station or a safely scoped official CPO tariff is published.
cpos.unblockRequires: A reproducible public DE*LMS direct-payment/QR tariff payload tied to a specific EVSE or station, or a current official Last Mile Solutions/Threeforce own-network tariff whose physical-CPO scope is explicitly proven.
